# Admin & compliance blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Admin & compliance blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## audit

Records inserts, updates and deletes with the actor and changed columns for tables you register, plus semantic events through audit_event(), with redaction, an append-only guard, a tenant read policy and per-tenant retention as options.

- Title: Audit log
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/audit
- Client: `auditBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/audit`
- Modes: `managed`
- Works with: `permissions`, `organizations`, `data-lifecycle`

## impersonation

Lets platform staff view the app as a user: time-limited, read-only by default, gated by is_platform() and a second admin's approval, recorded in the audit log, with the target's claims built by your access token hook.

- Title: Support sessions
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/impersonation
- Client: `impersonationBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/impersonation`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `permissions`, `audit`, `housekeeping`
- Works with: `invitations`, `approvals`, `housekeeping`
- Events (`ImpersonationEvents`): `support_session.ended`, `support_session.started`

## data-lifecycle

Data exports per user or organization from every installed module's tables and the app's, written to a private bucket by the app's export job, and organization deletion with a grace period that disables the tenant before a purge job deletes its rows.

- Title: Data lifecycle
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/data-lifecycle
- Client: `dataLifecycleBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/data-lifecycle`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `*`, `imports`
- Events (`DataLifecycleEvents`): `data_export.completed`, `data_export.failed`, `data_export.requested`, `data_subject_request.extended`, `data_subject_request.fulfilled`, `data_subject_request.received`, `data_subject_request.refused`, `data_subject_request.verified`, `legal_hold.placed`, `legal_hold.released`, `organization.deletion_cancelled`, `organization.deletion_requested`, `organization.purged`

## metrics

Metrics declared with defineMetric over a table (count, sum or avg per time bucket and dimension), rolled up into metric_points or read from the table, with metric_series and metric_value checked against a permission in the tenant.

- Title: Metrics
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/metrics
- Client: `metricsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/metrics`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `usage`, `queue`
- Provides: `sink`

## compliance

Compliance frameworks and their controls, evidence linked to controls (attachments or notes, with a validity date), recurring evidence tasks with assignees and an overdue state, a status rollup per framework, and policies published as frozen versions that members acknowledge through the acknowledgements block.

- Title: Compliance controls
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/compliance
- Client: `complianceBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/compliance`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `versions`, `acknowledgements`
- Works with: `attachments`, `notifications`, `outbox`, `audit`, `acknowledgements`
- Entities: `control`, `control_framework`, `evidence_task`, `compliance_policy`
- Tables: `controls`, `control_frameworks`, `evidence_tasks`, `compliance_policies`
- Permission keys: `compliance.read`, `compliance.manage`, `compliance.collect`
- Events (`ComplianceEvents`): `compliance_policy.published`, `control.created`, `control.evidence_added`, `control.updated`, `control_framework.imported`, `evidence_task.missed`

## consents

Consent per record and purpose: the purposes an organization asks consent for with their lawful basis and version, each decision with who made it (the person or a representative) and its signature, form or file as evidence, withdrawals and expiry. consent_active() answers whether processing may go ahead.

- Title: Consents
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/consents
- Client: `consentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/consents`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `contacts`, `relations`, `guests`, `signatures`, `forms`, `attachments`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `consent`, `consent_purpose`
- Tables: `consents`, `consent_purposes`
- Permission keys: `consents.read`, `consents.record`, `consents.manage`
- Events (`ConsentsEvents`): `consent.expired`, `consent.granted`, `consent.refused`, `consent.withdrawn`, `consent_purpose.created`, `consent_purpose.updated`, `consent_receipt.issued`, `consent_signal.recorded`
